Reconcile this provisional scope against SPEC.md, EVALUATION.md, BUILDPLAN.md, DESIGN.md, and the binding prototype before moving to in_planning; carry final AC IDs and the harness hook into the plan. Outcome/why: provide an independent terminal verdict, perform the authorized production deployment, and leave durable learning and next work only after the contract is truly satisfied. Outputs: fresh result-validator execution of the approved validation plan with per-AC pass/drift/risk/operator-smoke report; immutable deployment and post-deploy smoke, rollback readiness, and monitoring evidence; human go; Tone/Lattice retrospective; timeless lessons in LESSONS.md or CLAUDE.md; run-specific ledger; next roadmap; and run-state closeout. Completion evidence: missing evidence blocks the verdict, all required ACs pass, explicit human go is recorded before deploy, post-deploy checks and monitoring pass, rollback remains available, and no required work is left open. Human checkpoint: production go/deploy and any residual-risk acceptance require the named human approver. Contract/AC lineage: execute the approved EVALUATION.md exactly; terminal validation must be fresh and independent from builders.
data.title: Terminally validate, deploy, and close the Dreamlining run
